systems.system: Sistema de Informação Policial da África Ocidental (SIPAO)
systems.country_label: SIPAO; sistema integrado de informação criminal
systems.owner: a steering committee of several entities, whose first ordinary meeting the Minister of Justice and Human Rights spoke after on 17 April 2023; staffed by the Polícia Judiciária; INTERPOL accompanies and the European Union finances, per the minister
systems.tiers: one centre for collecting and processing criminal information; the minister said the other forces had not named full-time staff for its multidisciplinary team, leaving the work to Polícia Judiciária personnel

note: Describes SIPAO as sharing criminal information and data among ECOWAS countries over the INTERPOL channel, through one centre where all police forces are meant to work; the Polícia Judiciária's director says an integrated criminal information system for all criminal police bodies has been in force since the criminal investigation organisation law no. 8/2011. Nothing on stations entering reports or cases, so no fact.
